intent: Clear the small deferred findings the 2026-08 reviews recorded rather than fixed. Each was found, measured and consciously left, and each is named with its evidence: (1) LogInsights severityOf counts any line containing 'error' as an error, so a line reading 'no errors' inflates the error donut and depresses the clean-rate ring; (2) SyncScheduler keeps a per-source failure message and /api/monitor flattens it to ok/error, so the dashboard shows a red cross with no reason while the text exists and is discarded; (3) 19 raw colours remain, mostly per-series chart colours in viz components, which are legitimate values in the wrong place: they belong in tokens; (4) four dangerouslySetInnerHTML sites need a written reason each or a sanitiser; (5) @xyflow/react (213 KB) and motion (135 KB) load on every route while three pages use them; (6) /api/missions/[id]/run carries no requireAuth while its siblings do, which is not a hole because auth is enforced in proxy.ts, but the inconsistency invites the belief that routes without one are unprotected by choice.
